title: A one-press build runs to its last check: a saved plan answers the many-places question, places named in at are written, a planned build has room for a whole site, and the demo check says what to repair
steps: S1: content.replace with all:true over nine places of the EmDash fixture: no saved plan; a plan that is not agreed; a saved plan.
S2: content.replace with at naming two places of one find, in the core locate and on an open Joomla page that did not answer.
S3: loopNotices on 45 and 55 steps of looking and 150 and 205 steps of repairing, as a single change and as a planned build.
S4: cta-real on a nav item opening its own submenu with an empty href, one opening nothing, and a real page read with a Facebook link.
S5: runCapture given the address that answered.
S6: compareAgentInventory after a record's publication, relations, rows or routes changed, and with one record gone.
expect: S1: CONFIRM_FIRST and nothing written; CONFIRM_FIRST and nothing written; written.
S2: both places are targets; both records written, no AMBIGUOUS.
S3: a single change gets the turn-length and step-budget notices at 45; a planned build gets none at 45 or 150, the turn-length at 205 and the step budget at 55.
S4: the submenu parent passes, the other goes nowhere; Facebook is no booking and no call to action.
S5: every shot is taken at that address.
S6: the failure names the record and the part that moved; a gone record is named missing.
fence: the many-places ask in runReplace, the AMBIGUOUS rule in locate, BUILD_SCALE in loopNotices, cta-real's nav rule, runCapture's base, compareAgentInventory's detail

tests: many places at once: asked without a saved build plan, written with one, asked again when the plan is not agreed
locate: two places and no where/at/all → AMBIGUOUS, nothing written, each place with its at
🔒 part of a stored text in SEVERAL places, page unread
loopNotices: a planned build has five times the room of a single change, then the same notices
cta-real: dead, demo-service and off-site buttons fail
a capture given the address that answered shoots there, not at the first rule
Joomla inventory pages beyond100 and retains unpublished modules plus native menu assignments
